content.content: The crate is packaged and published as `deccy-cli`; the command users run stays `deccy`, carried by an explicit binary target named `deccy`.
content.rationale: The package name is the listing identity a registry picks and a reader finds, and this project's home is deccy-cli; the name a package is published under need not be the name of the command inside it. The command stays `deccy` (D10, wzmmmmsw) because the invocation is what users and their scripts already type, and a short command is what a human or an agent reaches for. Decoupling the two is the manifest's explicit binary target, so renaming the package leaves the command — and everything that renders it — intact.
